description: This source file defines the ImageImporterJpeg class responsible for importing and parsing JPEG images within the PDFsharp library. It includes methods for reading JPEG headers, verifying file signatures, and extracting image metadata such as DPI and color format. The file also contains related classes for handling JPEG image data and private data structures.

classes.name: ImageImporterJpeg
classes.description: Handles importing JPEG images, including header validation and metadata extraction.

classes.name: ImportedImageJpeg
classes.description: Represents an imported JPEG image with prepared image data for PDF embedding.

classes.name: ImageDataDct
classes.description: Holds the image data and its length for JPEG images.

classes.name: ImagePrivateDataDct
classes.description: Stores private data for JPEG images, including raw byte data and size.

methods.name: ImportImage
methods.description: Main method to import a JPEG image from a stream, verifying headers and extracting metadata.

methods.name: TestFileHeader
methods.description: Checks if the file starts with the JPEG SOI marker (0xffd8).

methods.name: TestJfifHeader
methods.description: Verifies if the JPEG file contains a JFIF header or other recognizable headers.

methods.name: TestJfifHeaderWorker
methods.description: Checks for the JFIF header specifics and extracts density information.

methods.name: TestExifHeaderWorker
methods.description: Checks for EXIF headers within the JPEG file.

methods.name: TestColorFormatHeader
methods.description: Determines the color format of the JPEG based on the SOS header components.

methods.name: TestInfoHeader
methods.description: Extracts image dimensions and components from the SOF header.

methods.name: MoveToNextHeader
methods.description: Advances the stream to the next header segment based on JPEG structure.

methods.name: PrepareImage
methods.description: Not implemented; intended to prepare image data for PDF embedding.
